user.title: Cactus Home
user.description: Run Needle 3 as a local conversation agent and Whistle as a local speech-to-text engine. The engine and model weights are downloaded and cached on first setup.

data.name: Name
data.assist_only: Only control entities exposed to Assist
data.enabled_domains: Entity domains to expose as tools
data.needle_weights: Path to a tuned Needle .cact archive (optional)
data.whistle_weights: Path to a tuned Whistle .cact archive (optional)
data.min_confidence: Confidence needed before acting without asking
data.max_targets: Maximum number of entities compiled into tools
data.max_enum_names: Maximum names listed per tool (0 disables name enums)
data.stt_keywords: Words and names to favour when transcribing (comma separated)
data.debug_audio_dir: Directory to save the last audio clip to, for debugging (optional)
data.threads: CPU threads for the model (0 = all cores)
data.target_cache_ttl: Seconds to cache the entity/tool snapshot

error.nothing_enabled: Enable at least one of the conversation agent or the speech-to-text engine.
error.cannot_connect: The Cactus engine could not be started.
